name: Owner.com $240M Series D — AI-native local growth
what_it_does: AI platform for restaurants/local businesses: discovery, first-party ordering, CRM, automated email/SMS/social marketing agents. Capitalized anti-marketplace thesis.
how_competitors_use_it: Sell flat-rate AI growth stack so independents leave DoorDash tech rent; agents write/publish promos into first-party channels.
what_we_use_today: Never86 love→buy-now on TikTok/IG + pain shoppers — social-native commerce, not full OS.
gap: Owner owns first-party web/order narrative with serious capital; we must stay sharp on shoppable social + complaint→sales, not copy their full OS.
summary: Primary vertical rival for anti-rent messaging. Differentiate: cult UGC proof → Never86 buy-now, not generic local-business OS.
